project.description: Full GraphLibraryDocument to persist (scenario + manifest with main and sub blueprints). Whole-document overwrite into blueprint.json.

title.description: Reserved human-readable label. Accepted for compatibility but currently ignored.

expectedRevision.description: Optimistic lock. Pass the revision this document was read at; the save is refused with errorCode revision.conflict if the document moved on. A revision inside project is ignored — the server owns the counter.

idempotencyKey.description: Stable identity for one logical whole-document save. Same key and content replay the original accepted revision.
